two_systems.system_a: the evaluator, validated against frozen gold
two_systems.system_b: the frozen Phase-6 generator, measured only after system A is validated

numeric_policy: deterministic exact-value comparison against structured Evidence fields first; mismatch = automatic CONTRADICTED; unstructured prose falls to semantic judge
multi_evidence_policy: gold specifies required_evidence_groups; claim support label reflects whether union of SUPPORTS/PARTIAL_SUPPORT citations covers every required fact; extra irrelevant citations flagged separately, do not fail the claim
answer_level_fully_grounded_rule: no FACTUAL claim UNSUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED; every FACTUAL claim has >=1 SUPPORTS/PARTIAL_SUPPORT citation; no fabricated source/reference; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED claims count as NOT fully grounded at answer level
citation_precision_definition: (citations judged SUPPORTS or PARTIAL_SUPPORT) / (total citations across FACTUAL claims) - PARTIAL_SUPPORT counts as correct
citation_coverage_definition: (FACTUAL claims with >=1 SUPPORTS/PARTIAL_SUPPORT citation) / (total FACTUAL claims) - 'citation recall' against a larger universe is never reported, no defensible denominator exists
same_model_caveat: Phase-6 generator and selected Phase-7 evaluator both use Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b; documented everywhere as 'a separate evaluation path validated against independently frozen gold', never 'cross-model independent validation'
